tools.name: search_datasets
tools.description: Search StackData's catalog of 50k+ official statistical datasets (SDMX/World Bank dataflows, China censuses and yearbooks, tariff schedules). Multilingual: an English query finds Chinese-titled tables. Returns dataset ids usable with the other tools.

tools.name: get_table
tools.description: Fetch a STORED table whole, by dataset id (families cn-nbs-census and cn-nbs-yearbook): labelled rows × columns with original-language labels, English overlay, units, and provenance down to the source file. Ids look like 'cn-nbs-census:2010_a0101a'.

tools.name: tariff_lookup
tools.description: As-of customs-tariff lookup: which measures/duty rates apply to a goods code in a jurisdiction (eu, us, uk, jp), optionally from an origin, on a date. Duty expressions are verbatim; every measure carries its legal citation. Not legal advice.

tools.name: resolve_data
tools.description: Ask a data question in English ('unemployment rate in Japan', 'compare GDP in Japan and Germany') — resolves to the best covering dataset and returns the observations, with coverage honesty (missing countries are reported, never papered over).

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "tariff_lookup" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
